Snow and the cold band are production settings; numeric temperature, feels-like and humidity are unknown. Producer note: winter running layers, gaiters and reflective accents are visible; look 02 eases to a walk, look 04 stops to adjust a glove cuff and look 05 checks a watch while cooling down (watch face mostly obscured, conservatively reconstructed); head and shoes are visible in all five.
